description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git repository selection logic, including creating git directories, cloning repositories, and verifying correct behaviors in ambiguous cases.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes directories used during testing to reset the environment.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository in a given directory and makes an initial commit.

methods.name: make_bare
methods.description: Creates a bare git repository and sets an initial commit.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches from a given repository and clones it into a new directory.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that the latest commit message matches expectations in both fetch and clone directories.
